Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write code that returns word or segment timestamps from a transcription result using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Transcribe:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 2 — Watson Speech to Text:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

Option 3 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 4 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

Option 5 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

Option 6 — AssemblyAI:
  Service: AssemblyAI Transcripts API
  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


def _s3_uri_from_path(path: str) -> str:
    if path.startswith("s3://"):
        return path
    raise ValueError("Amazon Transcribe requires an s3:// URI for the audio file.")


def _extract_items(transcript_result: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    results = transcript_result.get("results", {})
    items = results.get("items", []) if isinstance(results, dict) else []
    return items if isinstance(items, list) else []


def _normalize_timestamp(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, float]]]:
    item_type = item.get("type")
    if item_type == "pronunciation":
        alternatives = item.get("alternatives", [])
        word = alternatives[0].get("content") if alternatives else None
        start_time = item.get("start_time")
        end_time = item.get("end_time")
        if word is None or start_time is None or end_time is None:
            return None
        return {
            "type": "word",
            "text": word,
            "start_time": float(start_time),
            "end_time": float(end_time),
        }

    if item_type == "punctuation":
        alternatives = item.get("alternatives", [])
        text = alternatives[0].get("content") if alternatives else None
        if text is None:
            return None
        return {
            "type": "punctuation",
            "text": text,
        }

    return None


def transcribe_with_timestamps(
    audio_uri: str,
    language_code: str = "en-US",
    job_name: Optional[str] = None,
    output_bucket_name: Optional[str] = None,
    wait: bool = True,
    poll_interval_seconds: int = 5,
    region_name: Optional[str] = None,
) -> List[Dict[str, Union[str, float]]]:
    """
    Start an Amazon Transcribe job and return word/punctuation items with timestamps
    from the completed transcription result.

    Args:
        audio_uri: s3:// URI to the audio file.
        language_code: Transcription language code.
        job_name: Optional transcription job name. If omitted, a unique name is generated.
        output_bucket_name: Optional S3 bucket for the transcript output.
        wait: Whether to poll until the job completes.
        poll_interval_seconds: Polling interval while waiting.
        region_name: AWS region for the Transcribe client.

    Returns:
        A list of normalized transcript items, including word timestamps.
    """
    transcribe = boto3.client("transcribe", region_name=region_name)

    if job_name is None:
        job_name = f"transcription-{int(time.time())}"

    params: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "TranscriptionJobName": job_name,
        "LanguageCode": language_code,
        "Media": {"MediaFileUri": _s3_uri_from_path(audio_uri)},
    }
    if output_bucket_name:
        params["OutputBucketName"] = output_bucket_name

    try:
        transcribe.start_transcription_job(**params)
    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to start transcription job: {exc}") from exc

    if wait:
        while True:
            try:
                resp = transcribe.get_transcription_job(TranscriptionJobName=job_name)
            except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as exc:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to fetch transcription job status: {exc}") from exc

            job = resp.get("TranscriptionJob", {})
            status = job.get("TranscriptionJobStatus")
            if status == "COMPLETED":
                transcript = job.get("Transcript", {})
                transcript_uri = transcript.get("TranscriptFileUri")
                if not transcript_uri:
                    raise RuntimeError("Transcription completed but no transcript file URI was returned.")
                break
            if status == "FAILED":
                failure_reason = job.get("FailureReason", "Unknown failure")
                raise RuntimeError(f"Transcription job failed: {failure_reason}")
            time.sleep(poll_interval_seconds)

        s3 = boto3.client("s3", region_name=region_name)
        if transcript_uri.startswith("s3://"):
            _, _, remainder = transcript_uri.partition("s3://")
            bucket, _, key = remainder.partition("/")
            obj = s3.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
            transcript_data = obj["Body"].read().decode("utf-8")
        else:
            import urllib.request

            with urllib.request.urlopen(transcript_uri) as response:
                transcript_data = response.read().decode("utf-8")

        import json

        transcript_result = json.loads(transcript_data)
        items = _extract_items(transcript_result)
        normalized = []
        for item in items:
            parsed = _normalize_timestamp(item)
            if parsed is not None:
                normalized.append(parsed)
        return normalized

    return []
